chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Discovers Dragon Eggs and Begins Acupoint Divinization
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen finds dragon eggs on the beach and consumes one, triggering a painful transformation that plants a silver light point in his Shangqiu acupoint. A new cultivation path begins in the World of Immortality.
og_title: Xiao Chen's Dragon Egg Gambit - A New Cultivation Path Emerges
og_description: After a moment of calm, Xiao Chen discovers the eggs of the Eight-Armed Malignant Dragon. Consuming one leads to a painful transmutation and the birth of a silver light point in his Shangqiu acupoint, setting him on a unique path of acupoint divinization.
twitter_title: Dragon Egg Consumption and Acupoint Awakening in World of Immortality
twitter_description: Xiao Chen consumes a dragon egg, awakening a silver light point in his Shangqiu acupoint. A new cultivation path begins, but the mother dragon returns threatens danger.
